technique_name: Examine the impact of technology on global warming
description: Technology has had a major impact on global warming, both positive and negative. The production of electronic devices and other machinery results in the release of a substantial amount of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases which contribute to climate change. On the positive side, technological advances in renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power, as well as the increasing use of electric cars, have helped reduce carbon emissions.
